attributes.action: Justice for Existing ILR Applicants – Stop Changing the Rules!
attributes.additional_details:
Protect migrants who are already on an established ILR pathway from unfair retrospective immigration rule changes.
Honour legitimate expectations created by the immigration rules under which people originally entered the UK.
Introduce fair transitional arrangements
attributes.background:
Introduce fair transitional arrangements for existing visa holders.

Ensure that migrants who have completed the relevant qualifying period are treated fairly.

Ensure transparency, fairness and compassion in all decisions concerning Indefinite Leave to Remain.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action: "Legislate to protect ILR applicants from retrospective changes" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775267

You may also be interested in this petition: "Protect the five-year ILR route for existing Skilled Workers" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785621
